posts.name: AlterContacts
posts.tagline: AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead
posts.description: AlterContacts is a voice-first AI assistant that helps you remember every client and never miss an important follow-up. Just talk about your meeting, and Alter organizes the details, updates the client's profile, and remembers what you promised. It notices upcoming renewals, personal milestones, and relationships that need attention, then prepares your next message for approval. Built for financial advisors, brokers, and consultants who care about relationships, not CRM data entry.

posts.name: AI Context Flow MCP
posts.tagline: Memory you control, synced to every agent, tool and team
posts.description: Ten AI tools, ten partial memories, all drifting apart, with no record of who changed what. AI Context Flow fixes that with one shared memory over MCP. Save a client brief in Claude, and tomorrow your ChatGPT, Grok Bot and your teammate’s Cursor all work from the same version. Organize memory into buckets by project or client, choose who can access each one, and see every edit in full version history. If an agent overwrites something, roll it back.

posts.name: Codemany
posts.tagline: Run GitHub Actions 3x faster
posts.description: Run GitHub Actions on your own infra. Codemany orchestrates the runners: a fresh VM for each job. 3x faster, and NO per-minute bill. Our CI bill went from $215 in October to $4 so far in November. Free 14 days, no card.

posts.name: Glassmail
posts.tagline: A fast Mac email app with AI that never leaves your Mac
posts.description: Most new email apps charge you every month and send your mail to their servers so their AI can read it. Glassmail doesn't. It's a native Mac app for Gmail, iCloud, Outlook and any IMAP account, and its AI runs on your Mac. Ask "what needs me today?" and get an answer. Type "yes, but next week" and get a reply in your own voice. Clear your inbox one key at a time. There's no mail server and no subscription. You pay once, and it's yours.

posts.name: Exa Websets V2
posts.tagline: Build custom datasets from the live web, 4x faster
posts.description: Websets v2 is Exa’s update to its tool for building custom datasets from live web data. Describe what you want in plain language and get rows with sources and reasoning for each match. Per Exa, v2 finds 20% more matches, runs 4x faster and costs about 2x less than v1. The monthly subscription is gone, usage draws from Exa credits, searches are $5 per 1,000 requests, and API access is open to all users on the usage plan.

posts.name: Backspin
posts.tagline: Learn to DJ in your browser, on real vinyl decks
posts.description: Backspin teaches you to DJ in 21 short lessons that run on real turntables in your browser. It performs each move on the decks while you watch, then you try it and it tells you what to fix. Practice songs are built in, so you need no gear, no music files and no account. Free.

posts.name: OpenVorld
posts.tagline: Give your AI agents a home you can see
posts.description: OpenVorld is an open-source harness for AI agents, with a visible world on top. Every project is a pixel-art village, and every agent has a name, a role and a brain: Claude Code, Codex or any OpenAI-compatible API. You watch the crew work, and they ask before they use a folder, a command or a website. Free, open source and local. No account needed.

posts.name: Doddle
posts.tagline: Draw on what your videos for 3D effects
posts.description: Doddle is a camera for drawing on the world. Film a few steps, draw in the air or on a wall, and your lines stay where you put them. Pick a 3D pen, watch it draw itself, save a vertical video. Free to start; Pro is $6.99 once.

posts.name: Beat Watcher
posts.tagline: Fast Apple Watch heart rate alerts you can share with family
posts.description: Beat Watcher alerts you on Apple Watch the moment your heart rate goes above or below limits you set with the Digital Crown. Background Mode keeps watching when your wrist is down. Alert Sharing sends your alerts to family or friends you choose, in their own Beat Watcher app, free for them. The optional iPhone app can sound Critical Alerts on silent or Do Not Disturb and keeps an Alert History with notes and CSV export. People use it for pacing with POTS, stress awareness and rest.

posts.name: Shipyard
posts.tagline: MCP for Claude, Cursor and Codex to Automate Integrations
posts.description: Built for the vibecoding era, where anyone can build an app in a night and the slow part is everything around it. Shipyard is a local CLI and MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Connect your accounts once, then every new product gets its domain, DNS, hosting, database, email and payments set up automatically in about an hour. Your AI gets a build prompt for the exact stack. Ship more ideas, faster. Your keys never leave your computer.

posts.name: Prompt Puncher
posts.tagline: The AI CEO Fighting Game
posts.description: Prompt Puncher is a free browser fighting game where AI CEOs throw hands. Fight as Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, and more. No downloads or signups required.

posts.name: Hollr
posts.tagline: Push-to-talk for your family, on iPhone and Apple Watch
posts.description: Hollr is a walkie-talkie for your family. Hold one button, say it, let go. It works on iPhone and Apple Watch, including kids' Family Setup watches with no iPhone. Read a message when you can't listen, or react with a tap. Free for two people.

posts.name: Publicit
posts.tagline: Omnichannel ad infrastructure for marketers and AI agents
posts.description: Publicit is self-serve infrastructure to buy advertising across connected TV, street screens and mobile from one API. Choose audience and budget, upload your creative, and our real-time bidder buys the spaces on every channel, with delivery measured hour by hour. Each space shows its price before you buy. Sign-up is free. Built on OpenRTB, with a native MCP server to run campaigns from Claude or ChatGPT.

posts.name: Smorza
posts.tagline: Every Mac app gets its own volume and output
posts.description: Smorza is a free, open source menu bar app that gives every Mac app its own volume, mute and output. Put a call in your AirPods and music on your speakers, or turn a loud browser down without touching anything else. No audio driver, macOS 14.4+.

posts.name: AnyProfile
posts.tagline: Free open-source antidetect browser for Mac & Windows
posts.description: Free open-source antidetect browser for Mac & Windows. Isolate cookies, proxies, Android 15 VMs & AI MCP locally, with zero monthly fees.

posts.name: Stitch Loop
posts.tagline: Google’s AI agent that ships fixes and watches the metric
posts.description: Stitch Loop is an experimental product agent from Google Labs. It connects to your GitHub repo and live product data like logs, user behavior and feedback, proposes fixes, builds them in a cloud sandbox and opens a pull request. Nothing merges without human review. Built-in loops cover security, latency and accessibility, plus custom goals like checkout conversion. It keeps monitoring the metric after launch. Waitlist open worldwide, with priority for eligible Google AI Ultra users.

posts.name: LoudFlow
posts.tagline: We taught text to speech to think
posts.description: Most voices read the letters. LoudFlow understands the sentence first, so it sounds like a person, not a machine. Watch the video to hear the difference. Then select text in any app, press two keys, and listen. In any voice, even your own. Free on Mac and Windows.

posts.name: SuperMailbox
posts.tagline: Your email in one inbox, ready for AI
posts.description: Bring Gmail, iCloud Mail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts into one inbox. Find emails by meaning across languages with semantic search. Create mail rules and share access with your team. Connect ChatGPT, Claude or another compatible AI assistant through MCP to summarize threads and draft replies, with separate permissions for AI access. Plans start at $4.99/month with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: gitroots
posts.tagline: Path-level GitHub access for developers and AI agents
posts.description: gitroots is a governance layer for GitHub. Give each developer and AI agent access to only the paths they need, route their changes through approvals, and keep a searchable audit trail. Widen access to your code without handing over the whole repository.

posts.name: CROON
posts.tagline: Live dubbing for whatever's playing on your iPhone
posts.description: CROON dubs video or audio on your iPhone into your language as it plays, in a voice close to the speaker's. It works on top of the apps you already use. Turn CROON on once, then go back to your app and keep watching. When multiple people are talking, each keeps a separate voice. Free to download.

posts.name: WaitFeed
posts.tagline: Tech feed inside agent wait time
posts.description: Your agent is working. You’re sitting idle or bleeding focus into random tabs. Every wait is dead time that breaks your flow. WaitFeed kills it. It turns every wait into a powerful tech briefing, so you stay informed and locked in without ever leaving your terminal. Fresh dev stories, repos, and live developer discussions stream straight into your terminal. Never in your way. 100% local. Zero API keys. Zero tokens. Free and open source. One command and it’s live.

posts.name: Foundinity - Cofounder Matching
posts.tagline: Find a cofounder based on deeper compatibility
posts.description: A compatibility-focused cofounder matching platform that's designed to help you find and meet the most compatible profiles out there, faster!

posts.name: Cal Clear
posts.tagline: New: Outlook calendars, plus Teams and Meet links built in.
posts.description: Cal Clear is one free booking link that checks every calendar you connect, so “Tuesday works!” actually means Tuesday works. Google and Outlook live side by side, and Teams or Meet links tag along with every booking. Anti-spam keeps bots off your calendar, and buffer time plus minimum notice protect your breathing room. Every booking is email-verified and confirmed. Free forever, no ads, zero tracking, and your data is deleted automatically. Zoom is coming soon!

posts.name: Catastif
posts.tagline: Every list your household keeps, shared through iCloud
posts.description: Catastif keeps a household's lists in one place: groceries, things to buy, to-dos, ideas, recipes, birthdays and the week's meals. Type "2 lemons, milk, eggs x12" or say it, bring a recipe from a link or a photo, tick it off in the shop, and see what the others add as they add it. Plan the week's meals and shop days, split the cost of a shared shop, and keep your store cards a tap away. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. No account, no server, no ads: your lists sync through your own iCloud.

posts.name: Wiral.Social
posts.tagline: LinkedIn growth, for the rest of us
posts.description: Grow on LinkedIn without staring at a blank screen. Wiri (your AI-ghostwriter) learns your stories and opinions, then writes posts that sound like you, not AI. Get 3 fresh posts a day, catch mistakes before you post, and plan your whole week in 20 minutes.

posts.name: Creavit Studio 4.0
posts.tagline: Screen recording, iPhone camera and cinematic demos for Mac
posts.description: Plan, record and turn your screen into a product story. Creavit Studio 4.0 brings QR-paired iPhone portrait capture, camera takes added after recording, Content Planner, Standard and Liquid MultiFocus, cinematic 3D MacBook and iPhone scenes, Smooth Scroll, Smooth Typing, your voice in another language, and Auto FX with your approval at every stage. Built for Mac. Also available on iPhone for recording and editing on the go.

posts.name: Fenna Crew
posts.tagline: Grok Bot, but open source and on your Claude Code plan
posts.description: Grok Bot showed what bots with their own computer can do. Fenna Crew is the open source version that runs on your machine and uses the AI you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity. Give a bot a job and a schedule. It works in its own browser, files and docs, sheets and slides editors, never yours. Watch it, take over to type a password, and it asks before anything risky. No account, free, AGPL.

posts.name: Skin Hacker: Rosacea Tracker
posts.tagline: Skin health tracking app for sensitive & reactive skin
posts.description: A free, private tracker for sensitive, reactive, and rosacea-prone skin. Your pocket dermatologist. Log symptoms, food, skincare and daily habits. Skin Patterns reveals links between everyday factors and specific symptoms. Your Triggers Report groups potential triggers by estimated impact, helping you decide what to avoid first. Find your personal triggers for flare-ups, redness and breakouts, and spend less on skincare used to manage their aftermath.

posts.name: Click
posts.tagline: Build an Online Store From One Photo in 60 Seconds
posts.description: Click lets you create a fully functional online store in seconds. Upload a product photo and instantly generate product pages, marketing content, and shipping-ready storefronts powered by AI.

posts.name: Save to ClickUp
posts.tagline: Turn any email or webpage into a ClickUp task
posts.description: Open an email in Gmail or Outlook and the AI reads it, writes the task and files it in the right ClickUp list. Save any webpage as a task with a screenshot. Free on Chrome, Firefox and Edge, with 50 AI credits for a week.

posts.name: Colors & Fonts
posts.tagline: Palettes, Shaders , Gradients & Theme Tools
posts.description: Free color and design tools for designers and developers, now redesigned. New: a Shader Library of animated backgrounds you can open and customize, grid mesh gradients with CSS export, and an MCP server for Cursor, Claude and VS Code. Also: an animated shader builder with embed, PNG and video export, a theme builder that exports CSS, Tailwind, SCSS, Figma and JSON tokens, palettes, CSS gradients, color breakdowns, Google Font pairings and a color picker.

posts.name: LinkFeed
posts.tagline: A Chrome extension that gives LinkedIn X’s layout
posts.description: LinkedIn's feed always felt cluttered to me: a top bar, three columns of cards, ads in the sidebar. X's layout is much easier to read, so I built LinkFeed, a Chrome extension that gives LinkedIn that layout.

posts.name: EasyQA
posts.tagline: Resolve client feedback with your AI agent
posts.description: EasyQA lets your client comment on any element of a live website, then your AI agent reads the feedback, fixes the code, and publishes to the same link. Clients need no account. Leave voice notes, suggest new text, compare the build with your design, and run an audit for broken links, spelling, and SEO.

posts.name: Easy Lens CLI
posts.tagline: Build and publish Snapchat Lenses with AI
posts.description: Built for creators, developers, agencies and teams who want to move from idea to Lens without changing how they work.

posts.name: Amazon Opensearch Memory
posts.tagline: Give AI agents memory that lasts
posts.description: Add persistent memory to AI agents with searchable events, intelligent memory extraction, and context retrieval across sessions.

posts.name: AgentKombat
posts.tagline: AI Agent Battle Arena on Solana
posts.description: The arena where AI agents fight for real stakes. Build an agent on Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek or Kimi and fight in a 3D arena, free or for SOL.

posts.name: TickPDF
posts.tagline: Free Private PDF Editor: 100+ Tools, 160 Fonts, No Uploads
posts.description: Free PDF editor that runs in your browser. ✓ 100+ PDF tools: edit, sign, fill, convert, compress ✓ 160 fonts, matched exactly ✓ Reads 30+ languages ✓ Files never uploaded: the editor shows 0 files uploaded ✓ No sign-up, no watermark

posts.name: vkRetA
posts.tagline: Free website, GST billing and stock for Indian shops
posts.description: vkRetA gives an Indian small business its own website on yourname.vkreta.in, plus GST billing, stock, online orders, appointments and customer records, all in one place that runs on a phone. When a customer orders online, stock goes down, the bill is made and their history is saved. Free plan forever, with no coding and no card needed. Pro is ₹199/month with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: SparkKudos
posts.tagline: Make someone's workday brighter with a special thank-you
posts.description: A personal thank-you, a memorable reveal, one link. Free cards for coworkers and anyone you appreciate. No account needed.

posts.name: Pippin
posts.tagline: Stop keeping your to-do list by hand
posts.description: Keeping a to-do list should not feel like a second job. Pippin takes all the work out of keeping a todo list, from creating tasks to updating them to closing them, you don't have to lift your finger to do anything. Pippin turns email, chat, docs, anything on your Mac screen into tasks and keeps them up-to-date. Pippin categorises tasks by itself into categories. Forgot what you did three days ago? Ask Pippin in chat. Want to use pippin just as a memory layer? Hook your AI agent to it's MCP.

posts.name: AEO Growth
posts.tagline: Get more customers from AI answers
posts.description: Your customers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI who to buy from, and they trust what they hear. AEO Growth makes sure the answer is you. You'll see where you show up in AI answers today, how you stack up against your competitors, and what's holding you back. Then our team takes care of every fix, start to finish. Start with a free AI scan.

posts.name: tetris.rocks
posts.tagline: A modern, offline-capable Tetris in pure HTML and JS
posts.description: A free, open-source (MIT) Tetris in vanilla JS: Canvas, Web Audio, PWA. Four themes, including Vice, a GTA VI fan tribute. PGP-signed scoreboard receipts, no tracking, no cookies, no dependencies, no bundler. Open index.html and it runs.

posts.name: vexqo
posts.tagline: Meta Ad Library data for your apps and AI agents
posts.description: Build competitor ad research tools without maintaining scrapers. Search Meta's public Ad Library by keyword or advertiser and get JSON with creatives, run dates and platforms. Enrich ads with linked product data, or use MCP with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Also includes eBay listing data. Start with 500 free credits.

posts.name: HiMeet
posts.tagline: Chat with anyone in your own language. No app. No signup.
posts.description: Hi! I'm Sergey, and I built HiMeet because I was tired of language apps that make you install something, create yet another account, and still feel like you're talking to a robot. HiMeet is a chat that translates messages automatically in both directions. You write in your language, your friend reads it in theirs. No app to install, no account needed — just open a link and start typing.

posts.name: Intraface
posts.tagline: Let your Claude Code and your team's work from one board
posts.description: Intraface gives your team one live HTML page on one link. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or Gemini CLI. The agent pulls the latest version and the board's rules (collab.md), edits its own copy and publishes back. Publishes queue per board, merge onto the latest version and land with the person's and the agent's name. Pin comments on the live page and agents read and resolve them. Free to start.

posts.name: ambobs
posts.tagline: A quieter social network.
posts.description: A quieter, text-first social network for thoughtful posts, replies, and open conversations. Ambobs is a social network platform where users can share their thoughts, ideas, and stories. It offers various post types such as random posts, questions, ideas, news stories, experiments, notes, goals, and thoughts. The platform is designed for individuals looking to express themselves and connect with others through shared interests and hashtags.

posts.name: Subnano
posts.tagline: Where people and AI agents buy and sell digital work
posts.description: Subnano is a marketplace where people and AI agents buy and sell digital work: datasets, research, tools and articles, many with files to download. Pay per post in Nano or USDC, with no subscription. Connect Claude Code, Codex or another MCP client, and your agent can search, compare prices and buy within a limit you set, or pay over HTTP with x402. Sellers are paid to their own wallet on every sale. Can't find it? Post a Request with a brief and a budget.

posts.name: Nostos
posts.tagline: Rank 2,000 cities for nomad life, on open data
posts.description: Nostos ranks 2,000 cities for digital nomads on nine factors you weight yourself: cost, safety, internet, visas, climate and more. Or just ask Nestor, the AI advisor, in plain words. Every number links to its source and the full dataset is free to download. No account, no paywall. On web, iOS and Android.

posts.name: PaneFold
posts.tagline: Your desk, back the way you left it
posts.description: Stop rebuilding your desk every time you switch jobs. PaneFold is a Mac window manager that saves each job as a Scene: its apps, windows, browser tabs and files. Press its key and missing apps open, every window goes back in place, and the rest hides without quitting. Lay each Scene out with saved positions, auto-tile or a scrolling strip. Native, no account, Accessibility only, never Screen Recording. Pay once, after a 3-day trial.

posts.name: Rilo
posts.tagline: Calls and messages for kids, only with people you approve
posts.description: A first phone for kids of about 4 to 10, on an old phone with no SIM. They only call and message people a parent approved. No search, no photos or video, end-to-end encrypted, no trackers. iPhone, iPad and Android, EU and Norway. Free for 3 months.

posts.name: Merrin: Private Personal AI
posts.tagline: Private personal AI that remembers you, fully on-device
posts.description: Merrin is a private personal intelligence built on local AI, for your phone and computer. Talk or type about anything on your mind, or show it a photo. It remembers the people, plans and details you mention, turns meaningful chats into entries on its own, and helps you see patterns in your own thinking. The AI model runs locally on your device: no account, no cloud AI, and it works offline once downloaded. Pair your phone and desktop with end-to-end encrypted sync.

posts.name: LikeRemote
posts.tagline: Find a job faster. Hire real people, not bots.
posts.description: Job hunting is broken on both sides. Job seekers jump between job boards, type the same answers a hundred times, and hear nothing back. Recruiters drown in AI-written CVs sent by bots. LikeRemote fixes both. Job seekers find the jobs that fit them in one place, apply in one click, and stand out with a short video. Recruiters meet only verified, real people, see the best fit first, and never lose a good applicant. Your first job post is free.

posts.name: DisputeGuard
posts.tagline: Credit repair firms that want to ditch CreditRepairCloud
posts.description: DisputeGuard is the AI command center for credit repair. Our in-house credit pulls automatically feed reports into a powerful 3-stage AI workflow. Agent 1 audits all 8 credit report sections. Agent 2 uses intelligent dispute algorithms to rank negative items and build strategic dispute rounds. Agent 3 generates FCRA-informed dispute letters based on each strategy. Featuring integrated credit monitoring, automation, and white-label SaaS capabilities. With a client portal thats Fancy!.

posts.name: Vybscan
posts.tagline: Comprehensive secure SDLC: SAST, SCA, DAST, cloud posture
posts.description: AI code security scanner for AI-written code, with SAST, DAST, SCA, secret, IaC, license, and typosquat scanning on GitHub and GitLab pull requests and pushes. Provides special support for unsupported frameworks such as Frappe.

posts.name: Constellation
posts.tagline: Navigate your notes in 3D
posts.description: Have you heard about a second brain, Obsidian, or maybe Logseq? Constellation draws your notes as a 3D map that you can navigate on Apple Vision Pro, Mac, iPhone or iPad, and spot relationships between any Markdown files. You can also edit your notes in place, or use Siri to navigate around.

posts.name: SIGHTLINE™ PRO
posts.tagline: Multi-agent epistemic state machine & storyboard for fiction
posts.description: Play God with the timeline while keeping your characters mortal. Simulate visual/acoustic sightlines (🔒 Secrets vs 🙈 Blind Spots), audit continuity with 0-LLM linters, merge multiverse branches, and export to Word, Obsidian,fountain,ink &yarn.

posts.name: SpeechScroller
posts.tagline: The free teleprompter that scrolls with your voice
posts.description: SpeechScroller is a free teleprompter that follows your voice. Paste your script, press start, and read out loud. It scrolls to wherever you are, waits when you pause, and catches up if you skip ahead. Includes mirror mode for teleprompter glass, adjustable text size, on-screen notes, and live words per minute. No download, no signup, and your script stays in your browser.

posts.name: Summit AI Notes
posts.tagline: Private meeting notes, now on iPhone
posts.description: Summit is now on iPhone. With the free companion, record in-person meetings and read notes, transcripts, and action items on the go. Your Mac transcribes and summarizes the audio locally by default. Notes sync via iCloud with encryption. Since May, the Mac app has added MCP, AI answers with sources, Live Queries, screen video, live speaker recognition, Voice Keyboard, Split Recording, and smarter search. Get Summit for Mac directly or from the Mac App Store.

posts.name: Wallras
posts.tagline: Catch AI regressions before your customers do.
posts.description: Wallras is one self-hosted container between your app and your AI provider. It catches drift and silent model swaps, traces agent runs, tests prompts before release, flags shaky answers and keeps a tamper-evident log. Your data never leaves your servers.

posts.name: PlugAndPrompt
posts.tagline: Turn emails and PDFs into rows, with the proof attached
posts.description: Tell an AI agent, in plain words, what to pull from your emails, PDFs, scans and spreadsheets. Send one document or a whole batch: it works through them on its own, day and night, one row per document. Every value quotes where it was found. If a value is not there, it stays empty and says why. Checked, not guessed.

posts.name: IQFluence MCP
posts.tagline: Find and vet influencers inside Claude or ChatGPT
posts.description: IQFluence MCP brings influencer data into Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants. Search 455M+ Instagram, TikTok and YouTube creators. See which creators promoted your competitor, find lookalikes who haven't worked with them yet and read what their audience asks in the comments. Check fake followers and audience overlap, then set a budget per creator and get a draft media plan. You see the cost before every paid step. Start from 15 ready-made prompts. 5 free credits, no card required.

posts.name: INSYNCR
posts.tagline: PowerPoint reports that refresh from your own data
posts.description: A PowerPoint add in that binds slides to Excel, SQL Server, Salesforce and more. Link a recurring report once, refresh it in one click, or make one PowerPoint or PDF per client. Runs on your own Windows PC, uploads nothing. 7 day trial, no credit card.

posts.name: GeoAlarm
posts.tagline: Fell asleep on the bus? Wake up at your stop
posts.description: GeoAlarm is a free Android alarm that rings based on where you are, not what time it is. Pick your stop on the map, lock your phone and doze off: it rings when you get close, even with the screen off and the app closed. Motion alarms ring if someone picks up your phone or bag, and altitude alarms use the barometer to ring at a set height. No account, no ads, 30 languages. Your alarms and location stay on your phone.

posts.name: Ideogram 4.6
posts.tagline: Ideogram’s most precise editing model, with exact color
posts.description: Ideogram 4.6 is Ideogram’s new image generation and editing model for precise, multi-turn edits, with native output up to 4K. Per Ideogram, usable-result rates rose from 4.5 on exact color (46% to 83%) and character consistency (69% to 85%), with less pixel drift outside your edits. It supports masked Precise Edit and up to five reference images. It ranks first on Rapidata’s multi-step edit leaderboard. API prices start at $0.008 per image.

posts.name: runofsho
posts.tagline: Run of show software for live events
posts.description: runofsho is run of show software for live events. The show caller advances one shared rundown: the crew sees the active cue, speakers see their countdown, and the built-in prompter stays on the same cue. Guests and crew join by link with no account, and any browser can become a stage timer or backstage screen. Built for conferences, corporate events, broadcasts, livestreams and worship services, with every feature available through a public API.

posts.name: AI visibility set up FAST - bloggity
posts.tagline: builds a GEO / SEO optimized blog for your brand in minutes
posts.description: Your product needs a blog, but you don’t have time to run one. Bloggity builds an SEO- and GEO-optimized blog for your SaaS in minutes. Paste your landing page URL and it learns your voice, finds keywords (including your competitors’), and fills your content calendar. Toady, your AI editor, suggests posts with reasons and changes nothing until you approve. Built for founders running one product or several who want to be found on Google and in AI answers.

posts.name: Nitxy Pdf Editor Pro
posts.tagline: Edit the text inside any PDF, in your browser or on Windows
posts.description: NIT PDF Editor Pro is a PDF editor from Nitxy that edits the PDF itself, not just its pages. It is available as a web app that runs in the browser and as a Windows desktop app from the Microsoft Store. An Android app is planned. Windows app: - A desktop editor for heavier PDF work: edit PDF content, create PDFs, combine or merge files, extract pages and add comments. - Installed from the Microsoft Store. One Nitxy account works across the web and Windows apps.

posts.name: Slime Blast: Block Puzzle Game
posts.tagline: Slime Blast is a relaxing block puzzle game with a twist
posts.description: Slime Blast is a relaxing block puzzle game with a cute twist: every line you clear feeds Blobby, your squishy slime pet. Drag colorful jelly blocks onto the 8x8 board. Fill a row or column to blast it away, chain combos for big scores, and watch the goo flow straight to Blobby. Easy to learn, hard to put down. Love classic block puzzles, brain teasers or cozy pet games? Slime Blast turns every clear into a gooey reward. Download now and help Blobby become King!

posts.name: MotComplice
posts.tagline: A French word game to play with family, even on a video call
posts.description: MotComplice is a word game in French on a 15x15 board, made for playing with the people you love. Open a private room, share a code, and play with 2 to 4 friends or family members, even when you live far apart: everyone sees the same board live, and an optional audio or video call is built in. Prefer to play alone? Challenge Octave, the owl, at 3 levels, offline and without an account. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Subtle
posts.tagline: Beautiful captions for Claude Code, free and open source
posts.description: Subtle is a free, open source caption skill for Claude Code and Codex.

posts.name: PM Job Market Trends by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Weekly PM hiring data from 6,900+ company career pages
posts.description: A free, live view of product manager hiring, read every week from the career pages of 6,900+ tech companies and startups (13,000+ open PM roles). See demand by level, cities and countries, remote vs hybrid, base pay by level and city, the skills and AI experience roles ask for, and who's hiring. Filter by country, level, work mode and company type.

posts.name: Incognito Chat Saver
posts.tagline: save your Incognito chat on your computer - 100% safe.

posts.tagline: Simple, robust, self-hosted website monitoring
posts.description: Know your uptime at all times—100% self-hosted, with no guesswork, no heavy dependencies, and a responsive UI that works seamlessly on desktop and mobile.

posts.name: SysDesignPrep.com
posts.tagline: Practice system design interviews with an AI interviewer
posts.description: An AI interviewer that sees your whiteboard, probes your design and scores you like a hiring panel. Every walkthrough is free once you sign in: 86 questions, 493 deep dives, 199 guides. Pro is one payment, no subscription.

posts.name: ReelHatch
posts.tagline: AI UGC ads from a prompt or a link, in minutes
posts.description: ReelHatch makes finished UGC-style video ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Type a prompt, paste a product link or add photos, and an AI director writes the script, casts and voices the presenter, adds captions and music, then shoots and cuts the ad in about 9 minutes. Post it in one click or download the MP4. You see the price before you sign up, and you can make ads from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through the ReelHatch connector.

posts.name: Pratico
posts.tagline: Fast and secure containers for MacOS, agent and docker aware
posts.description: Pratico runs containers in their own isolated lightweight VM on your Mac, using the Virtualization Framework. behind a Docker-compatible API that you and your tools already use. Images are scanned on pull, daily and blocked on findings to prevent supply chain and security issues. Outbound connections are named and checked against threat feeds; light recorder logs what each container ran. Agents get an MCP endpoint for throwaway VMs, and ask mode holds each new destination until you allow it.

posts.name: milkyway.chat
posts.tagline: One AI chat for all frontier models for a better price.
posts.description: Stop overpaying for AI. No more 20$ Subscriptions. Stop paying for multiple AI subscriptions. Milkyway puts all frontier models in one chat. • image generation • Live web search, file and image uploads • Voice chat and MCP connectors • Bring your own API key, pay only for features and server-costs: $1.99/month • Plans from $9/month, cancel anytime

posts.name: Dayglass
posts.tagline: Bot-free meeting notes on your Mac, readable by Claude Code
posts.description: Dayglass is a private AI memory for your work day on Mac. It records Zoom, Teams and Google Meet without a bot joining, keeps audio, screen and notes on your Mac, and lets Claude Code and Cursor read your live call over MCP, so your agent knows what was decided while the call is still happening. Free for your first 10 meetings, no card. macOS 13+, Apple Silicon.

posts.name: Dibs
posts.tagline: Free sign-up sheets. No ads, no accounts, no app.
posts.description: Who's bringing what to Thanksgiving? Make a sign-up sheet in a minute, share one link, and people claim a spot from their phone. Free, no ads, no accounts. Works for volunteer shifts, carpools and class snacks too.

posts.name: Ibeiro
posts.tagline: Run festivals & markets: vendors, venue maps, staff, tasks
posts.description: Ibeiro is an event management tool for festivals, markets and fairs. Build vendor sign-up forms, review applications and permits, assign booths on a venue map, schedule staff, and track tasks and budgets, all in the browser. Try the full demo, no sign-up.

posts.name: LangFastPro
posts.tagline: Free stories to help you read Hindi, Urdu, Arabic & more
posts.description: Pick a short story in Hindi, Urdu, Arabic or one of five other languages and hit play. Each word lights up as it's read out. Can't read the script yet? Show it in English letters ("ek din" instead of एक दिन) or read the translation. Free, no signup.

posts.name: INDOX
posts.tagline: Edit translations, sign PDFs and grab text from any page
posts.description: INDOX lives in your browser's side panel and toolbar. Turn a file into another format, open a PDF to highlight and sign it, copy text out of any part of a page, or save an image with a right-click. Select text to translate it, fix a word in the translation, then copy it. Or send the selection to Ducky, the built-in assistant, and ask about it. Free to install for Chrome, Edge and Firefox.

posts.description: An AI interviewer that sees your whiteboard, probes your design and scores you like a hiring panel. Every walkthrough is free once you sign in: 86 questions, 493 deep dives, 199 guides. Pro is one payment, no subscription.

posts.name: WatchLog
posts.tagline: Your watch collection, every watch's drift and a timegrapher
posts.description: WatchLog keeps your mechanical watch collection in one place and tracks the accuracy of every watch in it. Add each watch, drawn in 3D, and see its drift at a glance. Tap as the seconds hand hits the mark: the reading is stamped with atomic time and charted in seconds per day against COSC, METAS and 18 other standards. The built-in timegrapher reads rate, beat error and amplitude through the microphone, no extra hardware. iPhone, iPad and Mac. Free for three watches, no account, no ads.

posts.name: PM Job Market Trends by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Weekly PM hiring data from 6,900+ company career pages
posts.description: A free, live view of product manager hiring, read every week from the career pages of 6,900+ tech companies and startups (13,000+ open PM roles). See demand by level, cities and countries, remote vs hybrid, base pay by level and city, the skills and AI experience roles ask for, and who's hiring. Filter by country, level, work mode and company type.

posts.name: Subtle
posts.tagline: Beautiful captions for Claude Code, free and open source
posts.description: Subtle is a free, open source caption skill for Claude Code and Codex.

posts.name: BenchmarkAI Research
posts.tagline: 4 AI models' stock research, in your assistant
posts.description: Stock research from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, inside your assistant. Read what each model's reports say about a US company, with the case for and against and dated sources. Check financials against SEC filings, review holdings you provide, or build a portfolio using the BenchmarkAI method, reviewing and approving each step. Connect through MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex or other remote MCP hosts. Free for personal use. In beta.

posts.name: Hailbell
posts.tagline: In-app support chat and push for iOS, Android and web
posts.description: Customers write from inside your app. An AI answers first from your docs and real prices, and you finish the reply from the inbox, Discord, Telegram or an AI agent. Each chat shows the customer's plan, purchases and device, and can open your paywall with an offer. Push goes to iOS, Android and web in one send, with segments, local time and quiet hours. Native Swift and Kotlin SDKs.

posts.name: Dawnroom
posts.tagline: Make and edit images on your own GPU. No credits, no cloud
posts.description: Dawnroom is an open-source image studio that runs on your own GPU. Describe an image, get an image. Describe a change, and it edits the rest untouched. Auto mode picks a model that fits your machine, 34 open models are in the library, and nothing leaves your computer. Use the Windows Studio, the CLI, a localhost OpenAI-compatible API, or an MCP server so Claude Code and Codex can generate images for you.

posts.name: Plugin Wizards
posts.tagline: 31 WooCommerce plugins that each do one job properly
posts.description: Plugin Wizards is 31 small WooCommerce plugins, each built for one job: table rate shipping, shipment tracking, wholesale pricing, product add-ons, BOGO deals, abandoned cart recovery and more. Install only what your store needs. Every plugin works with the block and classic checkout and HPOS, has a two-minute demo video and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Buy one plugin from $19 a year, or All Access for every plugin on one licence.

posts.name: Not Athletes Training
posts.tagline: A gym log for people who want to stick with it
posts.description: Not Athletes Training is a simple gym app for people who aren't athletes and want to stick with it. Build your workouts once from 700+ animated exercises, tap play at the gym, tick each set and beat what you lifted last time. Every session lands on a year-long calendar, and the app forecasts your year from your routine. Share any workout as a link and a friend can add it in one tap. Free, no subscription: sign in with an emailed code and add it to your home screen.

posts.name: Tinyping
posts.tagline: Your phone buzzes for every sign-up, sale and error
posts.description: Tinyping sends a push to your phone the moment something happens in your app: a sign-up, a payment, an error, a failed backup, a deploy. Add one HTTP request from any backend, or connect our MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can ping you. On Pro, Stripe, GitHub, Vercel, Sentry and AWS webhooks become readable alerts, a silent cron job rings you, and quiet hours keep nights calm. iPhone, Android and desktop, no app store. Free to start.

posts.name: Peck
posts.tagline: Woodpecker Method chess training, built from your own games
posts.description: Peck is a free trainer for the Woodpecker Method: build a set of chess puzzles, then solve it again in timed cycles until the patterns stick. It can build the set from the tactics you missed in your own Lichess or Chess.com games, and it reviews any game move by move for free. A missed-puzzle queue, weekly leagues, friends, ranks, linked ratings and opening sets give you reasons to come back. No ads. Peck Pro is optional.

posts.name: CutoutMotion
posts.tagline: Animated text behind the subject of your photo
posts.description: Upload a photo and CutoutMotion puts your words behind, around and through the person, pet, product or car in it, with a subtle 3D parallax camera move. It finds the subject automatically (or you tap it), offers 32 text animation styles, and saves a 3–10 second MP4 or a still image. Runs in the browser at cutoutmotion.com/app; videos are made on your device.

posts.name: NetZen AI
posts.tagline: Expert AI for MSPs and internal IT teams
posts.description: Service desk, RMM, patching and automation in one platform for MSPs and internal IT teams. The AI investigates tickets, runs endpoint diagnostics and fixes issues through automations, with optional approvals. One price: US$100 per technician a month, unlimited endpoints. 30-day free trial, no card.
